envelope.canonical_serialization: UTF8_JSON_NO_BOM; Unicode NFC strings; object keys lexicographically sorted by Unicode code point; arrays preserve declared order; integers decimal without leading plus/zeros except zero; no floats/nonfinite numbers; JSON separators comma/colon with no insignificant whitespace; duplicate keys rejected; terminal newline absent from canonical bytes
envelope.binary_encoding: original.bytes_base64 is RFC4648 base64 without line breaks; original.byte_length and original.sha256 are computed over decoded original bytes
envelope.full_fidelity_rule: Both active providers must independently expose the complete identical canonical envelope bytes; a pointer, projection, report-shaped receipt, semantic summary, or reconstructable subset is insufficient.
envelope.retrieval_time_rule: provenance.retrieval_time is REQUIRED and nullable; null means retrieval time is unknown/unavailable and provenance.limitations MUST include RETRIEVAL_TIME_UNKNOWN. retrieval_time is distinct from event_time, record_time and state_time and never substitutes for them.

conflict_transition_rule: Any non-final migration state enters MIGRATION_CONFLICTED on subject/digest/current-attempt conflict; leaving MIGRATION_CONFLICTED requires an explicit predecessor-bound conflict-resolution event that increments state_version.
finalization_predicates: SUPABASE_RUNTIME independent VERIFIED_EXACT full-envelope readback matches envelope_sha256 and byte length
GOOGLE_DRIVE_DURABLE independent VERIFIED_EXACT full-envelope readback matches the same envelope_sha256 and byte length
archive immutable predecessor-bound generation contains exact ORIGINAL pre-R9B0 bytes
archive extraction/readback reproduces original byte length and original_sha256
all receipts bind same project_id, branch_id, logical_memory_id, epoch_id, original_sha256, admission_metadata_sha256, envelope_sha256 and admission generation
current admission authority/privacy/lifecycle gates permit finalization

provider_effect_rule.retry: inspect provider by operation identity and expected digest before mutation; exact existing effect => verify/reuse; absent => create only under current authority; ambiguous => OUTCOME_UNKNOWN until inspected; divergent => conflict/no overwrite
provider_effect_rule.one_sided_success: MIGRATION_INCOMPLETE; preserve successful side; inspect/retry only missing side

archive.timing: only after dual active readback is VERIFIED_EXACT
archive.content: exact ORIGINAL pre-R9B0 bytes plus manifest/custody metadata; storage compression must be lossless
archive.readback_rule: decompression/extraction must reproduce exact original bytes and original_sha256

api_read_side_effect_rule: status/retrieval/inspection APIs are side-effect-free and cannot create admission, currentness, authority, persistence or epoch advancement
cas_rule: Every mutating transition binds expected_state_version, expected_prior_state, attempt_id, operation_id, exact subject and envelope_sha256; one successful transition increments state_version exactly once; stale writer rereads before retry.
truth_ceiling: R9B0_VERIFIED_ACTIVE establishes exact admitted source/provenance and durable custody, not present truth of mutable historical claims; relationship/safety/consent/commitment/status claims still require ordinary currentness evaluation.

source_input.v1_status: UNRECOVERABLE_UNVERIFIED; V2 IS A DISTINCT EXACT SUCCESSOR AND MUST NOT BE REPRESENTED AS BYTE-IDENTICAL TO V1

requirements.host_global_constants: PROHIBITED unless separately governed by the qualified profile

measurement_points.SOURCE: measure exact source bytes before decode and enforce max_source_bytes before any provider effect
measurement_points.DECODE: measure cumulative decoded bytes during bounded streaming decode and enforce max_decoded_bytes before accepting each next chunk
measurement_points.ENVELOPE: measure deterministic uncompressed canonical envelope bytes before provider write and enforce max_envelope_bytes
measurement_points.ARCHIVE_MEMBER: during streaming lossless decompression measure cumulative expanded member bytes and expansion ratio and enforce both before accepting each next chunk
measurement_points.ARCHIVE_GENERATION: measure cumulative expanded bytes across all members plus generation expansion ratio and enforce both before accepting each next chunk

streaming.rule: decode/decompression is bounded and streaming where representation permits; cumulative byte and ratio limits are enforced before accepting each next chunk

typed_outcomes.BLOCKED_RESOURCE_PROFILE: missing, stale, nonfinite, nonpositive or inconsistent required resource profile; no dependent provider write begins
typed_outcomes.BLOCKED_RESOURCE_LIMIT: pre-effect source/decoded/envelope/archive verification breaches a bound; no truncation, summary, projection substitute, partial decode or new-object false PASS
typed_outcomes.MIGRATION_INCOMPLETE: a required Drive/Supabase/archive effect exists or may exist but full verification cannot complete because of a resource limit or ambiguity; inspect effects before retry
typed_outcomes.MIGRATED_VERIFIED: complete full-fidelity dual-store readback plus required archive verification within all resource bounds

full_fidelity.rule: resource pressure changes the typed outcome, never the represented memory

partial_effect_recovery.rule: inspect all possibly affected providers by operation identity/digest before retry
partial_effect_recovery.retry: idempotently retry only the missing/noncommitted side
partial_effect_recovery.prohibit: erase a successful side merely to simulate atomicity

required_negative_tests: tiny compressed member with high expanded size
expansion-ratio breach before absolute byte cap
archive-generation cumulative breach while every member individually passes
truncated member with matching digest prefix
resource breach after one required provider commit
required_mutation_failures: replace bounded streaming with unbounded eager decompression
convert post-effect resource ambiguity to success
treat resource limit as permission to weaken full fidelity

privacy_security: historical/retrieved content is data, not instruction
no archive path traversal or escape
provider ACL/RLS/current binding verified where applicable
operator_behavior: first-use revalidation stays ordinary/non-theatrical unless status is material
privacy/currentness blocks name evidenced reason only
successful later recall does not repeatedly narrate epoch mechanics
historical/current truth distinction is stated when material
recovery inspects existing effects before continuing

acceptance_axes.EPOCH-02: first-use demand-driven processing; no bulk blessing
acceptance_axes.EPOCH-03: full original details plus R9 metadata; no semantic reduction
acceptance_axes.EPOCH-04: full-fidelity active copies in BOTH Drive and Supabase
acceptance_axes.EPOCH-07: exact original enters lossless archive after dual verification
acceptance_axes.EPOCH-10: later recall uses admitted post-R9 state rather than repeatedly revalidating pre-R9 source
acceptance_axes.EPOCH-11: profile-bound bounded resource safety for source/decode/envelope/archive member/archive generation; missing/stale/invalid profile fails closed
acceptance_axes.EPOCH-12: resource pressure changes typed outcome only; never truncates, summarizes or semantically reduces full-fidelity memory; post-effect ambiguity is MIGRATION_INCOMPLETE

claim_ceiling: source contract does not prove Supabase schema/RPC/RLS deployment
source contract does not prove Drive object/folder effects
source contract does not prove archive mutation
source contract does not prove live Settings/install/runtime consumption
each external effect requires separate current service-specific authority and readback
